basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast living in Springfield, MO. I work as an IT support specialist at a local firm, which keeps me busy during weekdays. I enjoy exploring behavioral economics theories and keeping my home secure with the latest tech gadgets. I have a soft spot for online series like those from McJuggerNuggets. Typically online during evenings and weekends. Not currently in a relationship but enjoy socializing with friends over tech meetups and gaming nights.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possess a degree in Information Technology and have gained substantial hands-on experience through my job in IT support. I spend a lot of my free time reading about behavioral economics and testing out new security systems for smart homes, often sharing my insights on these topics.
